TURN YOUR SONG INTO AN AI MUSIC VIDEO

Suvi is an AI Music Video generator for musicians, artists and creators promoting songs through short-form video.

Upload music created with Suno or your own original song. Choose a 15–60 second section and turn it into a polished, multi-scene AI MV in minutes on your iPhone—without filming, editing every clip or managing a complicated production workflow.

Whether you release music on Spotify or promote songs through TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts, Suvi transforms your music into engaging visual content.

 - ADVANCED AI VIDEO GENERATION

Suvi uses advanced, high-quality AI video models to create cinematic scenes and natural movement. Its intelligent system handles music analysis, visual planning, shot design, scene arrangement and editing, reducing the time and cost of traditional production.

 - EASY FOR BEGINNERS, POWERFUL FOR PROFESSIONALS

New to AI video? Upload one photo and a 15–60 second music clip. Suvi creates a cover, develops the visual concept, designs the shots and generates a polished short-form music video.

Want more control? Upload multiple reference images and enter a prompt of up to 30,000 characters. Specify the people, characters, locations, clothing, visual style, atmosphere and story you want.

Before generation, Suvi creates a story concept and cover image so you can preview the direction. Adjust your prompt or refine a template until it matches your vision.

 - STRONG CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

Use reference images to define singers, characters, locations, clothing, appearance, style and story details.

Suvi is designed to keep characters recognizable across scenes, actions and camera angles, creating a connected visual story instead of unrelated AI clips. This helps musicians and virtual artists build a consistent visual identity.

 - VISUALS THAT MOVE WITH YOUR MUSIC

Suvi analyzes the beat, lyrics, structure and emotion of your selected music. It arranges multiple scenes, designs shots and controls visual pacing. Verses can unfold through calmer scenes, while choruses can feature faster edits and more energetic movement.

The result is an AI Music Video whose editing rhythm and visual story feel connected to your song.

 - CREATE AI DANCE VIDEOS

Turn photos, music and prompts into rhythmic, trend-inspired dance videos. Suvi can choreograph popular dance movements, create performance scenes, and match character movement and editing pace to your music.

 - START WITH A TEMPLATE, MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Explore AI MV templates for different music genres, stories and styles. Generate quickly with a template, or customize its prompt and add reference images for a personalized result.

You do not need to manage a separate prompt for every shot. Suvi expands your idea into scenes and camera designs automatically.

 - MADE FOR MUSIC PROMOTION

Choose the 15–60 second section that best represents your song, then turn it into promotional content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.

FLEXIBLE FORMATS, WATERMARK-FREE EXPORT

Create videos in 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1 for different creative and publishing needs. Export without a watermark and share your AI MV across major social platforms.

 - SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Suvi offers auto-renewable Basic and Pro subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
